---
title: "Coding comparison"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(irr)
library(knitr)
```

# Read Data

```{r}
official_codes <- read.csv("filename.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
hand_or_chatgpt_codes <- read.csv("filename.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

# Coding Scheme

```{r}
codebook <- data.frame(
  Code = c("0", "1", "2", "NA"),
  Meaning = c(
    "Similarity cited",
    "Difference cited",
    "Not resolvable / unclear",
    "No response"
  )
)

kable(
  codebook,
  caption = "Coding Scheme"
)
```

# Identify Code Columns

Assumes coding variables end with `_code`.

```{r}
code_cols <- intersect(
  grep("_code$", names(official_codes), value = TRUE),
  grep("_code$", names(hand_or_chatgpt_codes), value = TRUE)
)

code_cols
```

# Verify Same Number of Rows

```{r}
if(nrow(official_codes) != nrow(hand_or_chatgpt_codes)){
  stop("Files contain different numbers of observations.")
}
```

# Find All Coding Disagreements

```{r}
all_differences <- bind_rows(
  lapply(code_cols, function(col){

    text_col <- sub("_code$", "", col)

    mismatch_rows <- which(
      as.character(official_codes[[col]]) !=
      as.character(hand_or_chatgpt_codes[[col]])
    )

    if(length(mismatch_rows) == 0) return(NULL)

    data.frame(
      row = mismatch_rows,
      variable = col,
      response = official_codes[[text_col]][mismatch_rows],
      official_code = official_codes[[col]][mismatch_rows],
      hand_or_chatgpt_code = hand_or_chatgpt_codes[[col]][mismatch_rows],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)
```

# Total Number of Disagreements

```{r}
total_disagreements <- nrow(all_differences)

cat(
  "Total disagreements:",
  total_disagreements,
  "\n"
)
```

# Percent Agreement

```{r}
total_cells <- nrow(official_codes) * length(code_cols)

percent_agreement <-
  (total_cells - total_disagreements) /
  total_cells * 100

cat(
  "Percent agreement:",
  round(percent_agreement, 2),
  "%\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Cohen's Kappa

kappa_data <- bind_rows(
  lapply(code_cols, function(col){
    data.frame(
      variable = col,
      official_code = as.character(official_codes[[col]]),
      hand_or_chatgpt_code = as.character(hand_or_chatgpt_codes[[col]])
    )
  })
)

# Remove rows where either coder has missing data
kappa_data_clean <- kappa_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(official_code), !is.na(hand_or_chatgpt_code))

# Cohen's kappa across all coded cells
kappa_result <- kappa2(
  kappa_data_clean[, c("official_code", "hand_or_chatgpt_code")]
)

kappa_result
```

# Disagreement Summary

```{r}
disagreement_summary <-
  all_differences %>%
  count(variable, sort = TRUE)

kable(
  disagreement_summary,
  caption = "Number of Disagreements by Variable"
)
```

```{r}
disagreement_types <-
  all_differences %>%
  count(official_code, hand_or_chatgpt_code, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    official_meaning = recode(
      as.character(official_code),
      "0" = "Similarity",
      "1" = "Difference",
      "2" = "Not resolvable",
      "NA" = "No response"
    ),
    hand_or_chatgpt_meaning = recode(
      as.character(hand_or_chatgpt_code),
      "0" = "Similarity",
      "1" = "Difference",
      "2" = "Not resolvable",
      "NA" = "No response"
    )
  )

kable(
  disagreement_types,
  caption = "Most Common Disagreement Types"
)
```

# Exact Disagreements

```{r}
kable(
  all_differences,
  caption = "Coding Disagreements with Original Response Text"
)
```

```{r}
# Code labels

code_labels <- c(
  "0" = "Similarity cited",
  "1" = "Difference cited",
  "2" = "Not resolvable / unclear",
  "NA" = "No response"
)

#Print Every Disagreement in Sentence Form

if(nrow(all_differences) > 0){

  for(i in seq_len(nrow(all_differences))){

    official_code <- as.character(all_differences$official_code[i])
    hand_or_chatgpt_code <- as.character(all_differences$hand_or_chatgpt_code[i])

    cat(
      'For text: "',
      all_differences$response[i],
      '", the official coding schema said ',
      official_code,
      " (",
      code_labels[official_code],
      "), but the hand or chatgpt coding schema said ",
      hand_or_chatgpt_code,
      " (",
      code_labels[hand_or_chatgpt_code],
      ").\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

} else {
  cat("No disagreements found.\n")
}
```
